Location: Northern Gulf – Louisiana coastal waters and Lake Pontchartrain east through Mississippi Sound, Mobile Bay, Pensacola Bay, Choctawhatchee Bay and St. Andrews Bay
Item: Gale warnings across the northern Gulf this weekend
Details: The National Weather Service has gale warnings up from 7pm CDT Fri Oct 16. Mobile Bay, Mississippi Sound, Perdido, Pensacola and Choctawhatchee Bays: north 20–30 kt, gusts to 35, waves up to 4 ft, until 7pm Sat. Coastal waters Pascagoula to the Okaloosa/Walton line (out 20 nm): N 20–30 kt, gusts to 40, seas 5–8 ft, until 1am Sun; 20–60 nm offshore: NE 25–35 kt, seas 8–11 ft. Louisiana coastal waters from Pascagoula to Southwest Pass, including Lake Pontchartrain, Lake Borgne and Breton Sound: NE 30–35 kt, gusts to 45, seas 8–14 ft, until midnight Sat. St. Andrews Bay: N 10–20 kt, gusts to 30; Mexico Beach–Okaloosa/Walton coastal waters N 20–30 kt, gusts to 40, seas 6–9 ft. Small-craft advisories follow into Monday. Why it matters: one week after Hurricane Isaias, damaged docks, temporary moorings and boats awaiting repair are especially vulnerable to a hard north blow – and a north wind will push water out of the bays, so expect lower-than-predicted water on shallow approaches.
When: 7pm CDT Fri Oct 16 – early Sun Oct 18 (small-craft advisories into Mon Oct 19)
Notes: What to do: postpone exposed passages until Sunday at the earliest, double up lines and add chafe gear, and check on any boat left at a storm-damaged marina before tonight. Weekend regattas in the area may be postponed – check with organizers. Times and wind figures are from the NWS Mobile, New Orleans and Tallahassee warnings issued Oct 16 (Mobile 9:40am CDT); check weather.gov/VHF WX for updates. Low-water effect from the north wind is general guidance, not from the warning text. State = AL as the central point; covers LA, MS, AL and the FL Panhandle. Map point: Mobile Bay.

Location: North Shore Park, 13001 N. Cleveland Ave (US 41), North Fort Myers – Caloosahatchee River
Item: River Romp Regatta – youth Junior Olympic sailing
Details: Edison Sailing Center's River Romp brings up to 225 young sailors to the Caloosahatchee in Optimists, ILCA 4s and 6s and Club 420s. First warning 10:30am Sat (11am for the Green Fleet), 9am Sun; no starts after 1pm Sunday. Why it matters: a chance to watch the next generation of racers, from shore, with a folding chair – the organizers welcome spectators.
Notes: What to do: watch from North Shore Park; if you're moving a boat on the Caloosahatchee near the US 41 bridges this weekend, slow down and give the race areas (near and south of the park) a wide berth. Contact: Stephanie Webb, 239-770-1575. Leashed pets OK; no alcohol or tobacco on park grounds. Found by Russ's parallel ChatGPT agent; details confirmed on the event page today.

Location: Lakewood Yacht Club, Seabrook (Clear Lake / Galveston Bay)
Item: Multihull Rendezvous at Lakewood Yacht Club
Details: A weekend for sailing cats, power cats and trimarans – owners, would-be owners and crew. Friday welcome social and live music, Saturday talks from industry experts, boat hopping, sundowners and dinner, Sunday brunch. $40 per person includes slip coordination in the inner harbor and a gift bag; an optional meal plan is extra (price not listed).
